CloudFolder.title: CloudFolder
CloudFolder.description: User-scoped folder metadata stored in Cloud Firestore for cross-device backup and sync. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp() for createdAt and updatedAt.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated Google user who owns this folder.

parentId.description: Parent folder ID, or empty string for root folders.

sortOrder.description: Custom ordering index for the folder.

createdAtMs.description: Client creation epoch timestamp in milliseconds.

updatedAtMs.description: Client update epoch timestamp in milliseconds.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

CloudScan.title: CloudScan
CloudScan.description: User-scoped scanned document record with compressed JPEG payload stored in Cloud Firestore. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp() for createdAt and updatedAt.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated Google user who owns this scan.

folderId.description: The ID of the parent folder containing this scan.

fileName.description: Display file name of the scan.

capturedAt.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when the scan was captured.

filterName.description: Applied scan enhancement filter enum name.

thumbBase64.description: Base64-encoded compressed JPEG image for cloud restore.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/folders/{folderId}.description: Stores folders owned by the authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/scans/{scanId}.description: Stores document scans owned by the authenticated user.
